info.name: National Health Record System API
info.description:
Patient-centric EHR platform for patients, doctors, and government hospitals with consent control, secure document storage, offline sync, and audit logging.

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Setup Database (First Time Only)
```bash
npm run seed
```

### 2. Login to Get Authorization Token
Use the **"Login (Default Admin) ⭐"** request in the Auth folder with these credentials:
- **Email:** admin@national-health-record-system.com
- **Password:** Admin@123456
- **Role:** Patient

### 3. Token is Auto-Saved!
The access token is automatically saved to the `{{accessToken}}` variable and used for all authenticated requests.

## 📋 API Endpoint Structure
- **Auth endpoints:** `/api/auth/*` (no version)
- **All other endpoints:** `/api/v1/*` (versioned)

## 🔐 Valid Role Values
- `Patient` - for patient users
- `Doctor` - for doctor users
- `HospitalAdmin` - for hospital administrators
- `SuperAdmin` - for super administrators

## ✨ Version 2.0.0 Updates
- Added Billing module (12 endpoints)
- Added Appointments (8 endpoints)
- Added Medical History (20+ endpoints)
- Added Lab Reports (11 endpoints)
- Added Telemedicine (14 endpoints)
- Enhanced P0 critical fix testing
